title: PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION, NO. ENV-2025-5195-MND, MITIGATION MEASURES, MITIGATION MONITORING…
text:
[Council File 26-1289; CD 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION, NO. ENV-2025-5195-MND, MITIGATION MEASURES, MITIGATION MONITORING PROGRAM, and RELATED CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA) FINDINGS, and ORDINANCE FIRST CONSIDERATION relative to a Zone Change and Height District Change for the properties located at 4802 – 4828 West San Vicente Boulevard.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. FIND, pursuant to Sections 21082.1(c)(3) and 21081.6 of the California Public Resources Code and CEQA Guidelines Section 15074(b), after consideration of the whole of the administrative record, including the Mitigated Negative Declaration, No. ENV-2025-5195- MND, and all comments received, with the imposition of mitigation measures, there is no substantial evidence that the Project will have a significant effect on the environment; FIND the Mitigated Negative Declaration reflects the independent judgment and analysis of the City; FIND the mitigation measures have been made enforceable conditions on the Project; and ADOPT the Mitigated Negative Declaration and the Mitigation Monitoring Program prepared for the Mitigated Negative Declaration.
2. ADOPT the FINDINGS of the Los Angeles City Planning Commission (LACPC) as the Findings of Council.
3. PRESENT and ADOPT the accompanying ORDINANCE, dated July 9, 2025, to effectuate a Zone Change and Height District Change, from C2-1-O to (T)(Q)C2-2D-O, in order to permit additional floor area up to a maximum Floor Area Ratio of 6:1 in lieu of 1.5:1, including a waiver of the requirement to dedicate and improve an additional 2.5 feet of the existing public alley; for the demolition and removal of the existing one- story warehouse building and two surface parking lots for the construction, use, and maintenance of a seven-story self-storage facility for household goods encompassing a floor area of 161,645 square feet, the self-storage facility would feature storage units across each floor level. Self-storage uses, including the office and lobby areas, will encompass 160,691 square feet and the multi-purpose community space area will encompass 954 square feet, the Project will provide, five vehicular parking spaces, 36 bicycle parking spaces, and two loading spaces and would operate between 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m., daily; for the property located at 4802 – 4828 West San Vicente Boulevard, subject to modified Conditions of Approval.
4. ADOPT technical modifications of Conditions, Findings, and Architectural Plans, as recommended by the Department of City Planning (DCP) report dated October 22, 2026, attached to the Council file.
Applicant: David Kelly, Westport Properties Inc.
Representative: Dana Sayles, Three6ixty Case No. CPC-2025-5194-HD-CU2-PR-ZC
Environmental No. ENV-2025-5195-MND
Related Case No. CPC-2025-5194-HD-CU2-PR-ZC-1A
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The LACPC reports that there is no General Fund impact as administrative costs are recovered through fees.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - DECEMBER 7, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - DECEMBER 4, 2026
summary: Zone and height district change for the same self-storage project at 4802–4828 West San Vicente Boulevard, raising the allowed floor area ratio from 1.5:1 to 6:1 and waiving a 2.5-foot alley widening.

locations.text: 4802 W San Vicente Blvd, Los Angeles, CA
